This vignette introduces the first package workflow for Project 1.

```{r}
library(ALRD)

set.seed(100)
dat <- data.frame(
  id = rep(1:40, each = 3),
  time = rep(1:3, times = 40)
)
dat$x <- rnorm(nrow(dat))
dat$a <- rbinom(nrow(dat), 1, plogis(0.2 + 0.5 * dat$x))
dat$y <- 1 + dat$x + dat$a * (0.5 + 0.25 * dat$x) +
  rnorm(nrow(dat), sd = 0.4)

fit <- fit_lrd(
  data = dat,
  id = "id",
  time = "time",
  treatment = "a",
  outcome = "y",
  covariates = "x",
  covariance = "ar1"
)

head(predict_ite(fit, dat))
```
